direct_answers.q01_workspace_single_or_multi: Multi conversation. Dedicated DB tables (chat_conversations, chat_messages), full CRUD API, and sidebar with New Chat in frontend.
direct_answers.q02_workspace_per_conversation_history: Persisted separately in DB per conversation_id, BUT backend does NOT feed ChatMessage history into the LLM context during inference.
direct_answers.q03_workspace_new_chat_reset: Yes, resets frontend activeId and message thread. Does NOT delete persistent user episodic memory across tickets.
direct_answers.q04_ticket_single_or_multi_thread: One message thread per ticket. Shared chronologically by User, Agent, Technician, and System in ticket_messages.
direct_answers.q05_ticket_load_previous_messages: Does NOT load raw chronological ticket_messages directly into LLM prompt; only loads message traces retrieved by Zero-Mem semantic/FTS search scoped to ticket_id.
direct_answers.q06_workspace_load_ticket_context: Yes, via Zero-Mem episodic retrieval (retrieves historical tickets submitted by the user within the tenant) or if ticket_id is explicitly passed in ChatRequest.
direct_answers.q07_ticket_load_workspace_chat_history: No. Workspace ChatMessage records are never indexed into Zero-Mem and are never retrieved in Ticket chat.
direct_answers.q08_episodic_memory_scope: Both Workspace chat and Ticket chat invoke retrieve_episodic_evidence() in zero_mem_service.py.
direct_answers.q09_rag_query_awareness: Workspace uses Query Decomposition on current message only. Ticket chat combines ticket.title + ticket.description + current_message.
direct_answers.q10_history_load_limit: Workspace loads 0 messages from chat history. Ticket chat loads 0 linear messages, only top 5-7 episodic memory traces.
direct_answers.q11_summary_compression: No active conversation summary compression runs in the active chat pipeline (rewrite_query_with_context exists in rag_service.py but is dead code).
direct_answers.q12_context_length_risk: LOW risk of context overflow (strict caps on RAG docs, memory traces, web snippets, and string slicing). HIGH risk of multi-turn conversational amnesia.
direct_answers.q13_streaming_non_streaming_parity: 100% identical context assembly across both Workspace (/chat vs /chat/stream) and Ticket (/tickets/{id}/messages vs /messages/stream).
direct_answers.q14_persisted_context: ChatMessage, TicketMessage, WebResearchRun, WebResearchSource, EpisodicMemoryTrace, EpisodicMemoryEntity, EpisodicMemoryFTS, AuditLog.
direct_answers.q15_transient_turn_context: Raw LLM prompt string, decomposed sub-queries, retrieved RAG document chunks in request memory, temporary SSE streaming buffer.

context_persistence_matrix.isolation_mechanism: DB Foreign Key & User ownership check
Sanitized query, no PII sent externally

identified_problems.name: WORKSPACE_CHAT_HISTORY_NOT_LOADED_INTO_LLM
identified_problems.description: POST /chat/conversations/{conv_id}/messages persists user ChatMessage in DB but delegates to chat_with_agent(ChatRequest(message=user_text)) without passing conv_id or loading previous ChatMessage records. The LLM receives 0 history messages, leading to conversational amnesia on multi-turn dialogue in Workspace.

identified_problems.name: TICKET_CHAT_LINEAR_HISTORY_OMITTED_FROM_DIRECT_PROMPT
identified_problems.description: In handle_ticket_message, previous ticket_messages are not passed as chronological chat turns. Instead, only episodic memory traces retrieved by Zero-Mem are passed. Short user follow-ups ('vẫn chưa được', 'thử rồi không được') rely solely on semantic retrieval which may fail to retrieve the immediately preceding agent instruction.

identified_problems.name: QUERY_REWRITE_HELPER_DEAD_CODE
identified_problems.description: rewrite_query_with_context() and is_context_dependent() exist in src/services/rag_service.py but are never called in chat.py or ticket_conversation_service.py.

identified_problems.name: NO_DYNAMIC_TOKEN_BUDGET_CALCULATION
identified_problems.description: Context bounding relies entirely on hardcoded item count limits and character slicing rather than a dynamic token budget calculator. While overflow risk is LOW, exact token utilization is not tracked at request prompt construction.
